title: The Pilgrim's Staff
text: A staff stands upright in the middle of the road where no one planted it, carved with the marks of all six shrines and worn smooth by a hand. It casts no shadow. The air around it smells faintly of incense.

options.label: The devout takes up the staff, as if it were left for them.

outcomes.text: It fits their hand as if made for it. The smell of incense follows them.

options.label: Leave it for its owner; someone will come back for it.

outcomes.text: Later a limping pilgrim passes and smiles to see it. He has no shadow either.

options.label: The strongest wrenches it from the road, whether it wishes to come or not.

outcomes.text: It does not want them. It twists their arms to say so.
